text: Multinational Enterprise Operations Management: Studies the strategic planning, organizational structure design, management of overseas branches, and optimization and coordination of global supply chains (such as procurement, production, and logistics) of multinational companies.International Market Expansion: Analyzes the market environment in different countries/regions (such as policies, culture, consumption habits), and formulates international marketing strategies for products/services, including international pricing, channel selection, brand localization, etc.International Finance and Settlement: Involves financial practices in cross-border trade, such as currency exchange, foreign exchange risk management, international payment methods (such as letters of credit, collections), cross-border investment and financing, etc.International Economic Law and Rules: Studies international trade agreements (such as WTO rules), bilateral/multilateral trade agreements, international commercial laws (such as contract law, intellectual property law), and response mechanisms for trade disputes.Cross-cultural Business Communication: Focuses on business etiquette, negotiation skills, and team collaboration models in different cultural backgrounds, and resolves communication barriers caused by cultural differences.Global Supply Chain and Trade: Discusses the process norms of international goods trade and service trade (such as cross-border e-commerce, international logistics), as well as risk management in supply chain globalization (such as geopolitical factors, logistics disruptions).
